text:
maria-chen: Heads up — CI started failing on the audit-schema-validator job after yesterday's RBAC change. Failing golden fixture for `audit.login` events that we ship to customers.

samir: saw it, failing assertion looks like `actor.service` is missing in the golden but present in the new payloads. quick paste of failing assert: 
```
E   AssertionError: payload missing keys: ['actor.service']
```

jordan_k: hmm, the RBAC patch renamed `actor_id` -> `actor.id` and added `actor.service` for system actions. Golden set hasn't been updated. Is this a schema change or an output normalization bug?

kevin: My read — the runtime is correct (we added `actor.service` to better surface system vs user). The validator schema still expects old shape for customer-facing events. So two paths: update schema + goldens (breaking change) OR transform runtime output before publishing (preserve backwards compat).

maria-chen: Customer-facing audit events should be stable. We need minimal customer break. Proposal: adjust schema to accept both shapes for a transition window, update golden fixtures in CI to include both variants, and schedule a non-breaking migration for 2 weeks from now. Thoughts?

samir: +1 for additive compatibility. I can prepare a patch to the jsonschema to make `actor.service` optional and accept either `actor_id` or `actor.id` via `oneOf` aliasing. Will also add a schema version field so we can roll stricter checks later.

jordan_k: thanks. Also let's add a small test harness that runs a canonical transformer before validator so we only change goldens once we agree on final shape. For immediate CI unblocking do we want to soft-fail the golden comparison and file a ticket?

kevin: please don't soft-fail in main CI. It'll mask regressions. Instead: create a temporary job `audit-schema-compat` that checks the new compat schema and marks failures as non-blocking on main but reports loudly. We can gate the release on passing that job. I'll create the job config.

audit-bot: New issue created: #SEC-4129 "audit schema compat: allow actor.service and alias actor.id" linked to this thread.

maria-chen: samir, can you drop the patch link here when ready and add instructions to update goldens? Also include a short note for release notes (compat window). I'll schedule a quick triage sync at 11:30 to sign off.

samir: will do, pushing branch now: `fix/audit-schema-compat-SEC-4129`. Tests locally: 43 passed, 2 xgoldens updated -> will open PR in ~30m.

jordan_k: once PR is up I'll run the `golden-diff` tool against customer-facing sample set and post the diff summary here. If diffs are purely additive we can proceed.

kevin: ping me on PR for the CI job change. I'll avoid rollbacks and coordinate with infra.

maria-chen: thanks all. Plan: (1) samir PR for schema compat + goldens, (2) kevin add non-blocking compat job, (3) jordan run diffs and sanity-check. Triage sync 11:30.

samir: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/audit-validator/pull/718 — includes schema changes + golden fixture updates + changelog note.

jordan_k: golden-diff summary: 2 files changed, both added `actor.service: "system"` in samples, no redactions altered. no customer-facing PII changes.

maria-chen: good. moving to review. If approved we'll merge and monitor canary for 24h. Keep alerts on. :eyes:
